metadata.title: Mohamed Elborno | Full Stack Software Engineer
metadata.description: The personal website of Mohamed Elborno; a Full Stack Software Engineer specializing in engineering custom ERP systems, architecting SaaS platforms, and integrating applied AI solutions.
metadata.ogTitle: Mohamed Elborno | Full Stack Software Engineer
metadata.ogDescription: Translating business complexities and workflows into robust technical systems that scale efficiently with business growth.

hero.headline: Architecting resilient systems that power your business.
hero.subheadline: Full Stack Engineer specializing in ERP, SaaS, and AI solutions. Translating complex business requirements into scalable, production-ready architectures managing the complete product lifecycle from inception to deployment.

about.label: About
about.role: Product-Focused Full Stack Engineer | Erzurum, Turkey
about.quote: The primary goal of software engineering is to build rigorous business logic that prevents data discrepancies and aligns perfectly with real-world operations.
about.p1: My practical experience lies in building custom business operations solutions. This includes engineering sales and invoicing engines that handle millions of SAR in monthly transaction flows while automatically integrating them with accounting journals, alongside real-time AI processing pipelines operating across 7 different languages.
about.p2: My expertise covers developing core ERP and supply chain modules, such as sales and procurement lifecycles, warehouse movement management, and building SaaS architectures. I take technical ownership of the product lifecycle from designing APIs and database schemas to frontend development and production deployment.
about.p3: Whether the challenge involves engineering intermediary credit ledgers to track balances and debit/credit movements with clear reference paths, or designing logistics workflows that handle stock validation and reservation prior to actual deduction; my ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between real business needs and deployed technical solutions.

erp.title: ERP Sales & Invoicing Engineering
erp.description: Building integrated sales workflows from APIs to frontend; including quotation management, automated linkage to receipts, rolling over excess amounts into customer balances, and architecting an integration-ready invoicing base for ZATCA compliance while syncing all movements automatically with the accounting general ledger.

financial.title: Credit Management & Audit Ledgers
financial.description: Developing an intermediary ledger system to manage credit requests and balance updates for clients and vendors. Strict tracking of every debit or credit movement with historical balance logging, transaction types, and deep reference tracking to eliminate race conditions.

ai.title: Applied AI Integration
ai.description: Deploying production-grade AI systems using cost-optimized LLMs for multilingual sentiment analysis, churn risk forecasting, and behavioral intelligence structured tailored to SaaS unit economics rather than basic proofs of concept.

saas.title: SaaS Architecture & Infrastructure
saas.description: Establishing comprehensive enterprise SaaS infrastructure, covering organization-based RBAC, subscription billing cycles, reactive real-time data pipelines, and interactive control panels. Handling the full spectrum from business logic requirements to final production deployment.

analytics.title: Customer Behavioral Analytics
analytics.description: Developing custom engines for real-time conversation analysis, customer churn evaluations, and team performance metrics. Transforming raw support metadata and behavioral touchpoints into structured, executive-ready insights.

database.title: Database Architecture & Optimization
database.description: Designing complex MongoDB and PostgreSQL schemas optimized for high-concurrency environments. Supporting 1,200+ active entities while guaranteeing data consistency, eliminating update race conditions, and tuning query execution paths under heavy operational loads.

erp.title: Developing the Sales Lifecycle and Logistics for a Steel Manufacturing ERP
erp.problem: A Saudi company with a massive transaction volume required strict automation to bridge accounting and logistics, eliminating discrepancies among financial receipts, customer credit balances, and live warehouse inventory deductions.
erp.decision: I built and developed the end-to-end quotation and receipt system, engineering an integrated business logic that links invoices, receipts, and delivery orders directly to the general ledger for real-time transaction posting. I designed an intermediary credit ledger (Log) to document credit details and established an invoicing structure ready for regulatory compliance.
erp.challenge: Separating sensitive financial data from the logistics module while maintaining workflow cohesion; ensuring no delivery order is processed without automated stock validation, and preventing actual stock deduction until confirmed by the warehouse keeper.
erp.result: A fully integrated, production-stable operational lifecycle ensuring absolute automated synchronization between field operations and the accounting general ledger, coupled with flexible credit and warehouse management, and zero discrepancies in live balances.

repvix.title: Repvix — AI-Powered Customer Analytics Platform
repvix.problem: B2B enterprises were generating thousands of unanalyzed customer conversations across WhatsApp and Zendesk, missing critical signals for churn risks, team performance metrics, and behavioral insights.
repvix.decision: Architected a real-time event pipeline using Convex and Node.js with a cost-optimized GPT-5 Mini integration. Built a custom Zendesk Sidebar app to embed real-time AI insights directly into workflows. Independently engineered the entire SaaS infrastructure (RBAC, billing, dashboards) in 6 weeks.
repvix.challenge: Achieving highly accurate, real-time multilingual sentiment and intent analysis across Arabic, Turkish, and English simultaneously, factoring in unique cultural and linguistic nuances affecting behavioral interpretation.
repvix.result: A live SaaS product (repvix.com) delivering multilingual AI analytics, automated churn risk detection, team performance evaluations, and executive dashboards. Built and shipped solo in 6 weeks.

isworb.title: isworb Platform for Corporate Classification
isworb.description: A specialized platform for monitoring and categorizing commercial enterprises based on their economic relations and dealings with the occupying entity. Contributed to the project as a Full Stack Developer along with data auditing to ensure the accuracy and integrity of the classifications.

danerdz.title: danerdz AI-Powered Educational Platform
danerdz.description: An AI-driven educational platform that processes and converts uploaded study materials and textbooks into automated flashcards and interactive quizzes, incorporating gamification elements like trophies and progress tracking.

grandfather.title: Digital Archive & Memorial Website
grandfather.description: A dedicated digital archive and memorial platform engineered to aggregate all of his books, writings, and multimedia clips into a centralized repository. Developed as a continuous charity (Sadaqah Jariyah) for him and the family, with a strong emphasis on content architecture and seamless readability.
